notes.title: Big update
notes.content:
Changes: 

- New "Below The Horizon" game mode
- Surface of the planet Lunaris
- Procedural planet terraformation system
- Storage system
- Hunger system


Fixes:

- A lot of fixes :D



(Ending and new story elements on the game mode "Below The Horizon" will be in the next update)

notes.title: Check out the new teaser for our biggest update yet
notes.content:
Check out the new teaser for our biggest update yet!

The update will include:

- New "Below The Horizon" game mode
- Surface of the planet Lunaris
- Procedural planet terraformation system
- New story with ending

Click:
https://i.postimg.cc/mrwZSFcr/Ready.png


This free update will be available in about 3 days.

notes.title: Hey survivors, we're planning the biggest update yet!
notes.content:
Hey survivors, we're planning the biggest update yet! 

In the new big update, players will be able to choose whether they want to survive above the atmosphere or on the surface of the planet Lunaris.

notes.content:
The price has been permanently reduced!

- Instead of the price of 1.99 €, the game has been reduced by 1 € to 0.99 €!
